title: Cross-Venue Prediction Market Spread Monitor Input

mode.title: Data mode
mode.description: Live retrieves current public market metadata and executable order books. Fixtures provides one deterministic test record.

stakeUsd.title: Analysis stake (USD)
stakeUsd.description: Total USD capital budget across both legs, including configured fees and safety buffer; no orders are placed.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of ranked candidate spread records to emit.

minSimilarity.title: Minimum title similarity
minSimilarity.description: Minimum token similarity required before deeper compatibility checks.

maxCloseHours.title: Maximum close-time difference (hours)
maxCloseHours.description: Maximum difference between venue market close times.

minNetReturnPct.title: Minimum estimated net return (%)
minNetReturnPct.description: Only emit candidates at or above this estimated post-buffer return.

feeRatePct.title: Estimated total fee rate (%)
feeRatePct.description: Conservative configurable estimate; confirm venue-specific fees manually.

slippageBufferPct.title: Safety buffer (%)
slippageBufferPct.description: Additional percentage of modeled acquisition cost reserved as a safety margin.

maxMarketsPerVenue.title: Maximum markets per venue
maxMarketsPerVenue.description: Hard cap on normalized active binary market metadata loaded from each venue.

maxSourcePages.title: Maximum source pages
maxSourcePages.description: Hard pagination cap applied independently to each venue.

maxBookPairs.title: Maximum matched pairs to hydrate
maxBookPairs.description: Maximum plausible cross-venue pairs whose executable order books are requested.

authorization.title: Live source authorization
authorization.description: Operator data-rights attestation. The deployed Actor defaults to the permissions confirmed for this private release.
